verses.original: לְמוֹאָ֡ב כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָמַר֩ ה֤וֹי אֶל־ נְבוֹ֙ כִּ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔דָה קִרְיָתָ֑יִם נִלְכְּדָ֖ה הֹבִ֥ישָׁה הַמִּשְׂגָּ֖ב וָחָֽתָּה׃ הֹבִ֥ישָׁה
verses.transliteration: lə·mō·w·’āḇ kōh- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar hō·w ’el- nə·ḇōw kî šud·dā·ḏāh qir·yā·ṯā·yim nil·kə·ḏāh hō·ḇî·šāh ham·miś·gāḇ wā·ḥāt·tāh hō·ḇî·šāh
verses.literal: Concerning Moab this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Woe to Nebo for it will be devastated Kiriathaim will be captured and disgraced the fortress will be shattered and dismantled

verses.original: אֵ֣ין עוֹד֮ תְּהִלַּ֣ת מוֹאָב֒ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן חָשְׁב֤וּ רָעָ֔ה עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ לְכ֖וּ וְנַכְרִיתֶ֣נָּה מִגּ֑וֹי גַּם־ מַדְמֵ֣ן תִּדֹּ֔מִּי חָֽרֶב׃ אַחֲרַ֖יִךְ תֵּ֥לֶךְ
verses.transliteration: ’ên ‘ō·wḏ tə·hil·laṯ mō·w·’āḇ bə·ḥeš·bō·wn ḥā·šə·ḇū rā·‘āh ‘ā·le·hā lə·ḵū wə·naḵ·rî·ṯen·nāh mig·gō·w gam- maḏ·mên tid·dōm·mî ḥā·reḇ ’a·ḥă·ra·yiḵ tê·leḵ
verses.literal: There is no longer praise for Moab in Heshbon they devise evil against her Come let us cut her off from nationhood You too O [people of] Madmen will be silenced the sword will pursue you

verses.original: ק֥וֹל צְעָקָ֖ה מֵחֹֽרוֹנָ֑יִם שֹׁ֖ד גָּדֽוֹל׃ וָשֶׁ֥בֶר
verses.transliteration: qō·wl ṣə·‘ā·qāh mê·ḥō·rō·w·nā·yim šōḏ gā·ḏō·wl wā·še·ḇer
verses.literal: A voice cries out from Horonaim Devastation and great destruction

verses.original: מוֹאָ֑ב הִשְׁמִ֥יעוּ נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה צְעוֹרֶיהָ׃ זְּעָקָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ hiš·mî·‘ū niš·bə·rāh ṣə·ʿō·rɛ·hå̄ zə·‘ā·qāh
verses.literal: Moab . . . will be shattered her little ones will cry out

verses.original: כִּ֚י מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַלֻּחוֹת בֶּ֑כִי בִּבְכִ֖י יַֽעֲלֶה־ כִּ֚י בְּמוֹרַ֣ד חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם צַֽעֲקַת־ צָרֵ֥י שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ שֶׁ֖בֶר
verses.transliteration: kî ma·‘ă·lêh hal·lu·ḥōṯ be·ḵî biḇ·ḵî ya·‘ă·leh- kî bə·mō·w·raḏ ḥō·w·rō·na·yim ṣa·‘ă·qaṯ- ṣā·rê šā·mê·‘ū še·ḇer
verses.literal: For on the ascent to Luhith they weep bitterly as they go and on the descent to Horonaim cries of distress resound over the destruction

verses.original: נֻ֖סוּ מַלְּט֣וּ נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וְתִֽהְיֶ֕ינָה כַּעֲרוֹעֵ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: nu·sū mal·lə·ṭū nap̄·šə·ḵem wə·ṯih·ye·nāh ka·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Flee Run for your lives Become like a juniper in the desert

verses.original: כִּ֠י יַ֣עַן בִּטְחֵ֤ךְ בְּמַעֲשַׂ֙יִךְ֙ וּבְא֣וֹצְרוֹתַ֔יִךְ אַ֖תְּ גַּם־ תִּלָּכֵ֑דִי כְמִישׁ וְיָצָ֤א בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה יַחַד׃ כֹּהֲנָ֥יו וְשָׂרָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: kî ya·‘an biṭ·ḥêḵ bə·ma·‘ă·śa·yiḵ ū·ḇə·’ō·wṣ·rō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ’at gam- til·lā·ḵê·ḏî ḵə·mīš wə·yā·ṣā bag·gō·w·lāh ya·ḥaḏ kō·hă·nāw wə·śā·rāw
verses.literal: - Because you trust in your works and treasures you too will be captured and Chemosh will go into exile with his priests and officials

verses.original: שֹׁדֵ֜ד וְיָבֹ֨א אֶל־ כָּל־ עִ֗יר לֹ֣א וְעִיר֙ תִמָּלֵ֔ט הָעֵ֖מֶק וְאָבַ֥ד הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר וְנִשְׁמַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃ אָמַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: šō·ḏêḏ wə·yā·ḇō ’el- kāl- ‘îr lō wə·‘îr ṯim·mā·lêṭ hā·‘ê·meq wə·’ā·ḇaḏ ham·mî·šōr wə·niš·maḏ ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ā·mar
verses.literal: The destroyer will move against every city and not one town will escape The valley will also be ruined and the high plain will be destroyed as the LORD has said

verses.original: תְּנוּ־ צִ֣יץ לְמוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י נָצֹ֖א תֵּצֵ֑א וְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ תִֽהְיֶ֔ינָה לְשַׁמָּ֣ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: tə·nū- ṣîṣ lə·mō·w·’āḇ kî nā·ṣō tê·ṣê wə·‘ā·re·hā ṯih·ye·nāh lə·šam·māh mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ bā·hên
verses.literal: Put salt on Moab for she will be laid waste . . . her cities will become desolate with no one to dwell in them

verses.original: אָר֗וּר רְמִיָּ֑ה עֹשֶׂ֛ה מְלֶ֥אכֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְאָר֕וּר מֹנֵ֥עַ חַרְבּ֖וֹ מִדָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr rə·mî·yāh ‘ō·śeh mə·le·ḵeṯ Yah·weh wə·’ā·rūr mō·nê·a‘ ḥar·bōw mid·dām
verses.literal: Cursed [is the one] who is remiss in doing the work of the LORD and cursed is he who withholds his sword from bloodshed

verses.original: מוֹאָ֜ב שַׁאֲנַ֨ן מִנְּעוּרָ֗יו וְשֹׁקֵ֥ט הוּא֙ אֶל־ שְׁמָרָ֔יו וְלֹֽא־ הוּרַ֤ק מִכְּלִי֙ אֶל־ כֶּ֔לִי לֹ֣א הָלָ֑ךְ וּבַגּוֹלָ֖ה עַל־ כֵּ֗ן טַעְמוֹ֙ בּ֔וֹ עָמַ֤ד וְרֵיח֖וֹ לֹ֥א נָמָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ ša·’ă·nan min·nə·‘ū·rāw wə·šō·qêṭ hū ’el- šə·mā·rāw wə·lō- hū·raq mik·kə·lî ’el- ke·lî lō hā·lāḵ ū·ḇag·gō·w·lāh ‘al- kên ṭa‘·mōw bōw ‘ā·maḏ wə·rê·ḥōw lō nā·mār
verses.literal: Moab has been at ease from youth settled . . . like wine on its dregs he has not been poured from vessel to vessel [or] gone into exile So . . . his flavor has remained the same and his aroma vvv is unchanged

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּ֖ה־ יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ ל֥וֹ צֹעִ֖ים וְצֵעֻ֑הוּ יָרִ֔יקוּ וְכֵלָ֣יו יְנַפֵּֽצוּ׃ וְנִבְלֵיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nêh- yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·šil·laḥ·tî- lōw ṣō·‘îm wə·ṣê·‘u·hū yā·rî·qū wə·ḵê·lāw yə·nap·pê·ṣū wə·niḇ·lê·hem
verses.literal: Therefore behold the days are coming declares the LORD when I will send to him wanderers who will pour him out They will empty his vessels and shatter his jars

verses.original: מוֹאָ֖ב וּבֹ֥שׁ מִכְּמ֑וֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֵּ֥ית בֹּ֙שׁוּ֙ מִבְטֶחָֽם׃ אֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ ū·ḇōš mik·kə·mō·wōš ka·’ă·šer- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl mib·bêṯ bō·šū miḇ·ṭe·ḥām ’êl
verses.literal: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh just as the house of Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ תֹּֽאמְר֔וּ אֲנָ֑חְנוּ גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים חַ֖יִל וְאַנְשֵׁי־ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ tō·mə·rū ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū gib·bō·w·rîm ḥa·yil wə·’an·šê- lam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: How can you say We are warriors mighty men ready for battle

verses.original: מוֹאָב֙ שֻׁדַּ֤ד וְעָרֶ֣יהָ עָלָ֔ה וּמִבְחַ֥ר בַּֽחוּרָ֖יו יָרְד֣וּ לַטָּ֑בַח נְאֻ֨ם־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שְׁמֽוֹ׃ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ šud·daḏ wə·‘ā·re·hā ‘ā·lāh ū·miḇ·ḥar ba·ḥū·rāw yā·rə·ḏū laṭ·ṭā·ḇaḥ nə·’um- ham·me·leḵ šə·mōw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Moab has been destroyed and its towns have been invaded the best of its young men have gone down in the slaughter declares the King whose name [is] the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: מוֹאָ֖ב אֵיד־ קָר֥וֹב לָב֑וֹא וְרָ֣עָת֔וֹ מִהֲרָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ ’êḏ- qā·rō·wḇ lā·ḇō·w wə·rā·‘ā·ṯōw mi·hă·rāh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Moab’s calamity is at hand . . . and his affliction is rushing swiftly

verses.original: נֻ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ כָּל־ סְבִיבָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל יֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ אִמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֤ה עֹ֔ז מַטֵּה־ נִשְׁבַּר֙ תִּפְאָרָֽה׃ מַקֵּ֖ל
verses.transliteration: nu·ḏū lōw kāl- sə·ḇî·ḇāw wə·ḵōl yō·ḏə·‘ê šə·mōw ’im·rū ’ê·ḵāh ‘ōz maṭ·ṭêh- niš·bar tip̄·’ā·rāh maq·qêl
verses.literal: Mourn for him all you who surround him everyone who knows his name tell how the mighty scepter is shattered the glorious staff

verses.original: רְדִ֤י מִכָּבוֹד֙ יֹשְׁבֶי בַצָּמָ֔א בַּת־ יֹשֶׁ֖בֶת דִּיב֑וֹן כִּֽי־ שֹׁדֵ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ עָ֣לָה בָ֔ךְ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ḏî mik·kā·ḇō·wḏ yō·šə·ḇɛ ḇaṣ·ṣā·mā baṯ- yō·še·ḇeṯ dî·ḇō·wn kî- šō·ḏêḏ mō·w·’āḇ ‘ā·lāh ḇāḵ ši·ḥêṯ miḇ·ṣā·rā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Come down from your glory sit on parched ground O daughter dwelling in Dibon for the destroyer of Moab has come against you he has destroyed your fortresses

verses.original: עִמְדִ֥י אֶל־ דֶּ֛רֶךְ וְצַפִּ֖י יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת עֲרוֹעֵ֑ר שַׁאֲלִי־ נָ֣ס וְנִמְלָ֔טָה אִמְרִ֖י מַה־ נִּֽהְיָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im·ḏî ’el- de·reḵ wə·ṣap·pî yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ‘ă·rō·w·‘êr ša·’ă·lî- nās wə·nim·lā·ṭāh ’im·rî mah- nih·yā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Stand by the road and watch O dweller of Aroer Ask the man fleeing or the woman escaping . . . What has happened

verses.original: מוֹאָ֛ב הֹבִ֥ישׁ כִּֽי־ חַ֖תָּה הֵילִילִי וּזְעָקִי הַגִּ֣ידוּ בְאַרְנ֔וֹן כִּ֥י מוֹאָֽב׃ שֻׁדַּ֖ד
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ hō·ḇîš kî- ḥat·tāh hē·lī·lī ū·zə·ʿå̄·qī hag·gî·ḏū ḇə·’ar·nō·wn kî mō·w·’āḇ šud·daḏ
verses.literal: Moab is put to shame for it has been shattered Wail and cry out Declare by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed

verses.original: וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט בָּ֖א אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֶל־ חֹל֥וֹן וְאֶל־ יַ֖הְצָה וְעַל־ מוֹפָעַת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·pāṭ bā ’el- ’e·reṣ ham·mî·šōr ’el- ḥō·lō·wn wə·’el- yah·ṣāh wə·‘al- mō·p̄å̄·ʿaṯ
verses.literal: Judgment has come upon vvv the high plain upon Holon . . . Jahzah and Mephaath

verses.original: וְעַל־ דִּיב֣וֹן וְעַל־ נְב֔וֹ וְעַל־ בֵּ֖ית דִּבְלָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- dî·ḇō·wn wə·‘al- nə·ḇōw wə·‘al- bêṯ diḇ·lā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: upon Dibon . . . Nebo and vvv Beth-diblathaim

verses.original: וְעַ֧ל קִרְיָתַ֛יִם וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית גָּמ֖וּל וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית מְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al qir·yā·ṯa·yim wə·‘al- bêṯ gā·mūl wə·‘al- bêṯ mə·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: upon Kiriathaim . . . vvv Beth-gamul and vvv Beth-meon

verses.original: וְעַל־ קְרִיּ֖וֹת וְעַל־ בָּצְרָ֑ה וְעַ֗ל כָּל־ עָרֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב הָרְחֹק֖וֹת וְהַקְּרֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- qə·rî·yō·wṯ wə·‘al- bāṣ·rāh wə·‘al kāl- ‘ā·rê ’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ hā·rə·ḥō·qō·wṯ wə·haq·qə·rō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: upon Kerioth . . . Bozrah . . . and all the towns vvv of Moab those far and near

verses.original: קֶ֣רֶן מוֹאָ֔ב נִגְדְּעָה֙ וּזְרֹע֖וֹ נִשְׁבָּ֑רָה נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qe·ren mō·w·’āḇ niḡ·də·‘āh ū·zə·rō·‘ōw niš·bā·rāh nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: The horn of Moab has been cut off and his arm is broken declares the LORD

verses.original: הַשְׁכִּירֻ֕הוּ כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֑יל עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה מוֹאָב֙ וְסָפַ֤ק בְּקִיא֔וֹ הֽוּא׃ גַּם־ וְהָיָ֥ה לִשְׂחֹ֖ק
verses.transliteration: haš·kî·ru·hū kî hiḡ·dîl ‘al- Yah·weh mō·w·’āḇ wə·sā·p̄aq bə·qî·’ōw hū gam- wə·hā·yāh liś·ḥōq
verses.literal: Make him drunk because he has magnified himself against the LORD so Moab will wallow in his own vomit and he will also become a laughingstock

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם׀ הָיָ֤ה ל֣וֹא יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְךָ֙ הַשְּׂחֹ֗ק נִמְצָאָה אִם־ בְּגַנָּבִ֖ים כִּֽי־ מִדֵּ֧י דְבָרֶ֥יךָ בּ֖וֹ תִּתְנוֹדָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im hā·yāh lō·w yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḵā haś·śə·ḥōq nim·ṣå̄·ʾå̄h ’im- bə·ḡan·nā·ḇîm kî- mid·dê ḏə·ḇā·re·ḵā bōw tiṯ·nō·w·ḏāḏ
verses.literal: - Was not Israel your object of ridicule Was he ever found [among thieves] - For whenever you speak of him you shake your head

verses.original: עִזְב֤וּ עָרִים֙ וְשִׁכְנ֣וּ בַּסֶּ֔לַע יֹשְׁבֵ֖י מוֹאָ֑ב וִֽהְי֣וּ כְיוֹנָ֔ה תְּקַנֵּ֖ן בְּעֶבְרֵ֥י פִי־ פָֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘iz·ḇū ‘ā·rîm wə·šiḵ·nū bas·se·la‘ yō·šə·ḇê mō·w·’āḇ wih·yū ḵə·yō·w·nāh tə·qan·nên bə·‘eḇ·rê p̄î- p̄ā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: Abandon the towns and settle among the rocks O dwellers of Moab Be like a dove that nests at the mouth of a cave

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ מוֹאָ֖ב גְאוֹן־ מְאֹ֑ד גֵּאֶ֣ה גָּבְה֧וֹ וּגְאוֹנ֛וֹ וְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ וְרֻ֥ם לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·nū mō·w·’āḇ ḡə·’ō·wn- mə·’ōḏ gê·’eh gā·ḇə·hōw ū·ḡə·’ō·w·nōw wə·ḡa·’ă·wā·ṯōw wə·rum lib·bōw
verses.literal: We have heard of Moab’s pomposity his exceeding pride [and] conceit his proud arrogance and haughtiness of heart

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ עֶבְרָת֖וֹ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא־ כֵ֑ן בַּדָּ֖יו לֹא־ כֵ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî ‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·lō- ḵên bad·dāw lō- ḵên ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: I know his insolence declares the LORD but it is futile . . . His boasting is as empty as his deeds

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ אֲיֵלִ֔יל עַל־ מוֹאָ֣ב אֶזְעָ֑ק כֻּלֹּ֖ה וּלְמוֹאָ֥ב יֶהְגֶּֽה׃ אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י קִֽיר־ חֶ֖רֶשׂ
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ă·yê·lîl ‘al- mō·w·’āḇ ’ez·‘āq kul·lōh ū·lə·mō·w·’āḇ yeh·geh ’el- ’an·šê qîr- ḥe·reś
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I will wail for Moab I will cry out for all of Moab I will moan for the men vvv of Kir-heres

verses.original: אֶבְכֶּה־ לָּךְ֙ הַגֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה מִבְּכִ֨י יַעְזֵ֤ר נְטִֽישֹׁתַ֙יִךְ֙ עָ֣בְרוּ יָ֔ם נָגָ֑עוּ עַ֛ד יָ֥ם יַעְזֵ֖ר שֹׁדֵ֥ד נָפָֽל׃ עַל־ קֵיצֵ֥ךְ וְעַל־ בְּצִירֵ֖ךְ
verses.transliteration: ’eḇ·keh- lāḵ hag·ge·p̄en śiḇ·māh mib·bə·ḵî ya‘·zêr nə·ṭî·šō·ṯa·yiḵ ‘ā·ḇə·rū yām nā·ḡā·‘ū ‘aḏ yām ya‘·zêr šō·ḏêḏ nā·p̄āl ‘al- qê·ṣêḵ wə·‘al- bə·ṣî·rêḵ
verses.literal: I will weep for you O vine of Sibmah more than I weep for Jazer Your tendrils have extended to the sea they reach [even] to - Jazer The destroyer has descended on your summer fruit . . . and grape harvest

verses.original: שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָגִ֛יל וְנֶאֶסְפָ֨ה מִכַּרְמֶ֖ל וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב הִשְׁבַּ֔תִּי וְיַ֙יִן֙ מִיקָבִ֣ים לֹֽא־ יִדְרֹ֣ךְ הֵידָ֔ד הֵידָ֖ד לֹ֥א הֵידָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: śim·ḥāh wā·ḡîl wə·ne·’es·p̄āh mik·kar·mel ū·mê·’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ hiš·bat·tî wə·ya·yin mî·qā·ḇîm lō- yiḏ·rōḵ hê·ḏāḏ hê·ḏāḏ lō hê·ḏāḏ
verses.literal: Joy and gladness are removed from the orchard and from the fields of Moab I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses no one treads them with shouts of joy their shouts are not for joy

verses.original: מִזַּעֲקַ֨ת חֶשְׁבּ֜וֹן עַד־ אֶלְעָלֵ֗ה נָתְנ֣וּ קוֹלָ֔ם עַד־ יַ֙הַץ֙ מִצֹּ֙עַר֙ עַד־ חֹ֣רֹנַ֔יִם עֶגְלַ֖ת שְׁלִֽשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֚י גַּם־ מֵ֣י נִמְרִ֔ים יִהְיֽוּ׃ לִמְשַׁמּ֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: miz·za·‘ă·qaṯ ḥeš·bō·wn ‘aḏ- ’el·‘ā·lêh nā·ṯə·nū qō·w·lām ‘aḏ- ya·haṣ miṣ·ṣō·‘ar ‘aḏ- ḥō·rō·na·yim ‘eḡ·laṯ šə·li·šî·yāh kî gam- mê nim·rîm yih·yū lim·šam·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: There is a cry from Heshbon to Elealeh they raise their voices to Jahaz from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah . . . for even the waters of Nimrim vvv have dried up

verses.original: לְמוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י מַעֲלֶ֣ה בָמָ֔ה וּמַקְטִ֖יר לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lə·mō·w·’āḇ nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·hiš·bat·tî ma·‘ă·leh ḇā·māh ū·maq·ṭîr lê·lō·hāw
verses.literal: In Moab declares the LORD I will bring an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֞ן לִבִּ֤י יֶהֱמֶ֔ה כַּחֲלִלִ֣ים לְמוֹאָב֙ וְלִבִּי֙ יֶהֱמֶ֑ה כַּחֲלִילִ֖ים אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י קִֽיר־ חֶ֔רֶשׂ עַל־ כֵּ֛ן יִתְרַ֥ת עָשָׂ֖ה אָבָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên lib·bî ye·hĕ·meh ka·ḥă·li·lîm lə·mō·w·’āḇ wə·lib·bî ye·hĕ·meh ka·ḥă·lî·lîm ’el- ’an·šê qîr- ḥe·reś ‘al- kên yiṯ·raṯ ‘ā·śāh ’ā·ḇā·ḏū
verses.literal: Therefore . . . My heart laments like a flute for Moab [it] laments like a flute for the men vvv of Kir-heres because . . . the wealth they acquired has perished

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל־ רֹאשׁ֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְכָל־ זָקָ֖ן גְּרֻעָ֑ה עַ֤ל כָּל־ יָדַ֙יִם֙ גְּדֻדֹ֔ת וְעַל־ מָתְנַ֖יִם שָֽׂק׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl rōš qā·rə·ḥāh wə·ḵāl zā·qān gə·ru·‘āh ‘al kāl- yā·ḏa·yim gə·ḏu·ḏōṯ wə·‘al- mā·ṯə·na·yim śāq
verses.literal: For every head is shaved and every beard is clipped on every hand is a gash and around every waist [is] sackcloth

verses.original: עַ֣ל כָּל־ גַּגּ֥וֹת מוֹאָ֛ב וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶ֖יהָ כֻּלֹּ֣ה מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּֽי־ שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי אֶת־ מוֹאָ֗ב אֵֽין־ חֵ֥פֶץ כִּכְלִ֛י בּ֖וֹ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al kāl- gag·gō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ ū·ḇir·ḥō·ḇō·ṯe·hā kul·lōh mis·pêḏ kî- šā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ ’ên- ḥê·p̄eṣ kiḵ·lî bōw nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: On all the rooftops of Moab and in the public squares everyone is mourning for I have shattered - Moab vvv like an unwanted jar declares the LORD

verses.original: אֵ֥יךְ חַ֙תָּה֙ הֵילִ֔ילוּ אֵ֛יךְ מוֹאָ֖ב הִפְנָה־ עֹ֥רֶף בּ֑וֹשׁ מוֹאָ֛ב וְהָיָ֥ה לִשְׂחֹ֥ק וְלִמְחִתָּ֖ה לְכָל־ סְבִיבָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ ḥat·tāh hê·lî·lū ’êḵ mō·w·’āḇ hip̄·nāh- ‘ō·rep̄ bō·wōš mō·w·’āḇ wə·hā·yāh liś·ḥōq wə·lim·ḥit·tāh lə·ḵāl sə·ḇî·ḇāw
verses.literal: How shattered [it is] How they wail How Moab has turned his back in shame Moab has become an object of ridicule and horror to all those around him

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר הִנֵּ֥ה כַנֶּ֖שֶׁר יִדְאֶ֑ה וּפָרַ֥שׂ כְּנָפָ֖יו אֶל־ מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nêh ḵan·ne·šer yiḏ·’eh ū·p̄ā·raś kə·nā·p̄āw ’el- mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says Behold an eagle swoops down and spreads his wings against Moab

verses.original: הַקְּרִיּ֔וֹת נִלְכְּדָה֙ וְהַמְּצָד֖וֹת נִתְפָּ֑שָׂה הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם לֵ֞ב מוֹאָב֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֤י וְֽ֠הָיָה כְּלֵ֖ב אִשָּׁ֥ה מְצֵרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qə·rî·yō·wṯ nil·kə·ḏāh wə·ham·mə·ṣā·ḏō·wṯ niṯ·pā·śāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm lêḇ mō·w·’āḇ gib·bō·w·rê wə·hā·yāh kə·lêḇ ’iš·šāh mə·ṣê·rāh
verses.literal: Kirioth has been taken and the strongholds seized In that day the heart of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor

verses.original: מוֹאָ֖ב וְנִשְׁמַ֥ד מֵעָ֑ם כִּ֥י הִגְדִּֽיל׃ עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ wə·niš·maḏ mê·‘ām kî hiḡ·dîl ‘al- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because he vaunted himself against the LORD

verses.original: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֛יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב מוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: pa·ḥaḏ wā·p̄a·ḥaṯ wā·p̄āḥ ‘ā·le·ḵā yō·wō·šêḇ mō·w·’āḇ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Terror and pit and snare await you O dweller of Moab declares the LORD

verses.original: הַנִּיס מִפְּנֵ֤י הַפַּ֙חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־ הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעֹלֶה֙ מִן־ הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־ אָבִ֨יא אֵלֶ֧יהָ אֶל־ מוֹאָ֛ב שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: han·nīs mip·pə·nê hap·pa·ḥaḏ yip·pōl ’el- hap·pa·ḥaṯ wə·hā·‘ō·leh min- hap·pa·ḥaṯ yil·lā·ḵêḏ bap·pāḥ kî- ’ā·ḇî ’ê·le·hā ’el- mō·w·’āḇ šə·naṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Whoever flees . . . the panic will fall into the pit and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare For I will bring upon . . . Moab the year of their punishment declares the LORD

verses.original: נָסִ֑ים עָמְד֖וּ מִכֹּ֣חַ חֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן בְּצֵ֥ל כִּֽי־ אֵ֞שׁ יָצָ֣א מֵחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן וְלֶֽהָבָה֙ מִבֵּ֣ין סִיח֔וֹן וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ פְּאַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְקָדְקֹ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: nā·sîm ‘ā·mə·ḏū mik·kō·aḥ ḥeš·bō·wn bə·ṣêl kî- ’êš yā·ṣā mê·ḥeš·bō·wn wə·le·hā·ḇāh mib·bên sî·ḥō·wn wat·tō·ḵal pə·’aṯ mō·w·’āḇ wə·qā·ḏə·qōḏ bə·nê šā·’ō·wn
verses.literal: Those who flee will stand helpless in Heshbon’s shadow because fire has gone forth from Heshbon and a flame from within Sihon It devours the foreheads of Moab and the skulls of the sons of tumult

verses.original: אוֹי־ לְךָ֣ מוֹאָ֔ב עַם־ כְּמ֑וֹשׁ אָבַ֖ד כִּֽי־ בָנֶ֙יךָ֙ לֻקְּח֤וּ בַּשֶּׁ֔בִי וּבְנֹתֶ֖יךָ בַּשִּׁבְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w- lə·ḵā mō·w·’āḇ ‘am- kə·mō·wōš ’ā·ḇaḏ kî- ḇā·ne·ḵā luq·qə·ḥū baš·še·ḇî ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā baš·šiḇ·yāh
verses.literal: Woe to you O Moab The people of Chemosh have perished for your sons have been taken into exile and your daughters have gone into captivity

verses.original: בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִ֖ים וְשַׁבְתִּ֧י מוֹאָ֛ב שְׁבוּת־ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הֵ֖נָּה עַד־ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט מוֹאָֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm wə·šaḇ·tî mō·w·’āḇ šə·ḇūṯ- nə·’um- Yah·weh hên·nāh ‘aḏ- miš·paṭ mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: Yet in the latter days I will restore Moab from captivity declares the LORD Here ends the judgment on Moab
